title: Pan-Seared Cashew Crusted Salmon
description: A flavorful and crunchy salmon dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the salmon fillet and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a food processor, grind the light cashew and roasted cashew into a fine crumb.
Mix the ground cashew with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Coat the salmon fillet evenly with the cashew mixture.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sear the salmon for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Let the salmon rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
